messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a console/ui deploy TONIGHT 18:30 UTC. Canary on a 10% slot for 15m, then gradual ramp. Need CDN invalidation and edge prefetch before canary. @sam you free to kick off?

sam: I can do the push at 18:30. Build tag is release/console-v2.14.1. Will keep rollback ready.

lee: I can run invalidation. Do we want a prefix purge (static/) or explicit paths?

jess: Prefetching static assets ahead of canary. I'll run the warmup script ~5m before the switch.

sam: Plan I have in mind:
1) prefetch edges (jess)
2) canary slot -> 10% (18:30)
3) smoke checks for 15m (maya/ryan)
4) if green, ramp 50% after 10m then 100% after 30m
Rollback tag: console-v2.14.0 (kept in registry)

maya: Smoke checklist: load home, open console, run quick search, sign-in with SSO, and a few basic flows (create notebook). If we see >5% errors or spike in 500s, abort. @ryan can you watch logs + latency dashboards?

ryan: Watching. I'll alert on 500 rate >3% or 99th latency > 1s. Will post updates here.

ops-bot: preflight: artifacts present: console-v2.14.1.tar.gz, bundle-hash abc123. Health checks OK.

lee: Invalidation commands I'll run (pick one):
```
# CloudFront invalidation (bulk)
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3EXAMPLE --paths "/static/*" "/console/*"

# Fastly example
curl -X POST https://api.fastly.com/service/FASTLY_SERVICE_ID/purge -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" -d '{"surrogate_keys":["console-assets"]}'
```

jess: Warmup snippet I'll run from a small fleet in front of edges to pre-populate caches:
```
for p in / /app /console /static/main.js; do 
  curl -sS https://console.redwood.ai${p} > /dev/null || echo "warmup fail ${p}"
done
```

sam: I'll keep the rollback command handy: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console --to-revision=prev` and we can re-tag traffic to the previous canary slot.

maya: If any of the smoke steps fail, we abort and tag the run "rollback-1749998888". Signal on #eng-releases, and we'll coordinate a hotfix if needed.

jess: quick note — there are a couple of long-tail static files (fonts) that sometimes miss prefetch. I'll add them to the warmup list.

sam: ack. I'll start the deploy window notes in the release doc and ping here at t-10 and t-1. :thumbsup:

lee: invalidation queued, will post invalidation id once it's submitted.

maya: thanks all — see you in the thread at 18:20 for final green.
